scope: Prevent TABLECONTENT from claiming semantic completeness while linked-cell data or ATTDEF cell attributes are structurally consumed but not retained.

method.kind: Focused parser behavior change with generated in-memory object vectors
method.evidenceRule: Generated source-authored vectors exercise only the documented parser field profile encoded by this test; they do not establish producer compatibility, object dispatch completeness, consumer acceptance, or linked-graph round-trip support.

vectors.payload: linked-data flag, DATALINK handle, row/column metadata, and opaque unknown value
vectors.expected: Structural parse succeeds and m_parseComplete is true, while m_semanticContentComplete is false.

vectors.payload: one cell-content ATTDEF handle, text, and index tuple
vectors.expected: Structural parse succeeds and m_parseComplete is true, while m_semanticContentComplete is false.

payloads: linked-data flag, DATALINK handle, row/column metadata, and opaque unknown value
one cell-content ATTDEF handle, text, and index tuple
vectors.expected: Outer TABLE prefix parses successfully; semantic completeness is false; partial columns/rows are not published; cursor remains at TABLECONTENT start.

implementation.semanticCompleteness: parseTableContent reports structural parsing separately from completeness; skipped linked-cell and ATTDEF payloads mark the result incomplete and emit a focused debug diagnostic.
implementation.fallback: No adapter or writer code changed. The existing incomplete-table exclusion from semantic TABLE output and INSERT projection path remain unchanged.
implementation.publicModel: DRW_TableContentObject exposes m_semanticContentComplete and reset clears it. This changes public class layout, so downstream consumers must rebuild; no DRW_Interface virtual was added.

doesNotEstablish: typed retention of DATALINK handle, BL93/BL94/BL96 values, or ATTDEF tuples
reference-closed DATALINK ownership, dispatch, DXF emission, or handle remapping
all AC1021 or AC1024+ TABLECONTENT profiles

planImpact.nextSlice: 7G.3d.3b typed linked-cell metadata and ATTDEF tuple retention, with bounds, reset/copy, and both AC1021/AC1024 generated vectors
